requirements.requirement: weekly; ≥3 years and current CBOT Soybeans COT observation
requirements.policy: CFTC public API; exact SOYBEANS futures-only disaggregated contract

requirements.requirement: daily/weekly SOYB issuer shares or holdings
requirements.policy: lawful issuer publications only; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: monthly; ≥30 years of dated ONI history
requirements.policy: NOAA CPC official ONI; ENSO is context and cannot substitute for crop-region weather

requirements.requirement: daily; ≥3 years for grain/USD regimes
requirements.policy: reuse one Federal Reserve/FRED semantic series across commodity profiles; no commodity-specific clone

requirements.requirement: daily; ≥3 years of producer BRL/ARS and importer CNY against USD
requirements.policy: primary central-bank or lawful market history with exact FX bases and roles; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: current front-month CBOT Soybeans futures quote
requirements.policy: reuse the swarm pulse quote transport (`@S.1`); label it US¢/bu futures; no connector clone

requirements.requirement: point-in-time CBOT Soybeans close history with source identity
requirements.policy: reuse lawful shared market history for `@S.1`; continuous back-adjusted futures

requirements.requirement: point-in-time CBOT Corn close history aligned to soybeans
requirements.policy: reuse lawful shared market history for `@C.1`; the soybean/corn ratio is one acreage cluster

requirements.requirement: point-in-time CBOT Soybean Meal close history aligned to beans
requirements.policy: reuse lawful shared market history for `@SM.1`; meal is one crush-product confirmation

requirements.requirement: point-in-time CBOT Soybean Oil close history aligned to beans
requirements.policy: reuse lawful shared market history for `@BO.1`; oil is one crush-product confirmation

requirements.requirement: current old-crop/new-crop CBOT settlements with ≥3 years of curve snapshots
requirements.policy: CME official or licensed settlements with exact contracts; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: current and historical bean/meal/oil crush using aligned contract months
requirements.policy: lawful CME settlements with stated conversion yields and fees; reject mismatched months

requirements.requirement: current US Gulf, Brazil and Argentina basis net of FX, taxes and freight
requirements.policy: primary customs/port data or licensed assessments with location and grade; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: monthly; current point-in-time US and world supply/use tables
requirements.policy: USDA WAOB official XML; revisions retained; production cells are bridge inputs and cannot cast a second demand vote

requirements.requirement: monthly; ≥10 years of US, world and major-exporter ending stocks and stocks-to-use
requirements.policy: USDA primary balances with inaccessible China stocks separated and revisions retained; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: weekly in season; ≥10 years by state/region
requirements.policy: USDA NASS and equivalent primary crop reports with release vintage; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: current plus ≥30 years of daily yield-weighted weather aligned to flowering/pod fill
requirements.policy: primary meteorological observations/forecasts with geography, model run and expiry; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: current US, Brazil and Argentina acreage/yield/output with dispersion
requirements.policy: USDA, CONAB and other primary crop releases; do not duplicate WASDE balance signals

requirements.requirement: weekly; ≥5 market years of US sales, reductions/adjustments and shipments by destination
requirements.policy: USDA FAS primary data; preserve China as a destination and separate gross sales, net sales and physical shipment

requirements.requirement: monthly/current China customs arrivals by origin
requirements.policy: primary Chinese customs data; US sales and announced purchases cannot substitute for arrival

requirements.requirement: monthly physical crush, meal/oil output and product stocks
requirements.policy: USDA NASS/EIA and primary industry releases; reconcile joint-product yields and avoid double counting

requirements.requirement: monthly realised soybean-oil biofuel use and feedstock share
requirements.policy: EIA/USDA primary physical-use data; mandates and credits cannot cast this demand vote

requirements.requirement: current dated mandates, credits and blend-rule changes
requirements.policy: primary regulator publications with effective date and expiry; policy cannot cast a physical-demand vote

requirements.requirement: current tariffs/export taxes, port constraints and verified rerouting
requirements.policy: primary government, customs and port evidence; start from pre-policy supply and do not recount production

requirements.requirement: current marginal farm cash-cost and crush/export-parity range
requirements.policy: primary farm budgets/input prices and lawful product values; separate observed price, model range and market expectation
